title: Streaming text arrives chunk by chunk
summary:
Text streams stop arriving all at once, chat accepts more reasoning settings, and IDPhotoGen joins the creative directory.

Streaming POST requests now bypass request deduplication, which had buffered responses before returning them. SSE chunks can arrive as they are generated; non-streaming requests still use deduplication.

Chat completions now accept `none`, `minimal`, and `xhigh` for `reasoning_effort`, alongside `low`, `medium`, and `high`.

The creative app directory now includes @thangoffer91’s IDPhotoGen, an AI app for making professional ID photos.
